notes.note: Reviewed permission-denial follow-through in paired profiles: typed HTTP status controls the interval policy, 401/403 pauses automatic polling, scoped keys and HTTP authority guards remain in place, and cached names stay hidden on error. Real QueryClient tests verify one denied request over a minute, an explicit retry caller receiving the new data, and polling resuming after success. Prior accounting and source-completeness limits remain open.

Existing numeric refetchInterval consumers, infinite-query page shapes, cancellation and cache semantics are unchanged; undefined preserves the numeric interval and false pauses it.
